Deterministic scripts first, LLM judgment second

Validation

--validate · --strict · --approve

Validation runs in two layers. Scripts catch anything answerable by parsing YAML, walking the graph, or counting fields — deterministically, with no LLM involved. The LLM layer runs second and judges only what requires reading prose and weighing meaning. Neither layer can substitute for the other.

SCRIPT FIRST, LLM SECOND

Operating Principle 3 — the split is non-negotiable

If a check can be answered by walking graph edges or counting items, it belongs in a script. If it needs to understand the words, it belongs in the LLM layer. This rule is enforced — any heuristic in a script that judges prose quality must be removed.

Script layer — structural

Runs check_traceability.py, check_consistency.py, build_traceability_matrix.py, spec_graph.py. Each emits a findings JSON and exits 0 — the orchestration layer reads severities.

orphan_story orphan_epic orphan_prd dangling_link missing_ac dup_id invalid_id dep_cycle dep_dangling goal_without_metric unknown_enum parse_error

LLM layer — judgment

Runs after scripts. Reads prose, weighs meaning, and checks alignment. Two anchored checks (time_realism, competitive_drift) are pinned to script-precomputed numbers so the LLM cannot hallucinate.

invest_quality vagueness core_value_drift gold_plating semantic_duplication contradiction time_realism competitive_drift
WHAT --VALIDATE CHECKS

Errors block with --strict; warns are always advisory

The check catalog has two severity levels in the validate gate. advisory exists only for the out-of-gate time_advisory.py (overdue) which consumes the wall clock and is never part of the reproducible gate.

Check ID Owner Sev What triggers it
orphan_storyscripterrorStory with no epic field
orphan_epicscripterrorEpic with no prd field
dangling_linkscripterrorAny frontmatter ID reference that doesn't resolve
missing_acscripterrorStory with empty or missing acceptance_criteria
goal_without_metricscripterrorBRD goal with no metrics slug
dep_cyclescripterrorCircular depends_on chain
contradictionLLMerrorNew claim contradicts an approved artifact
low_ac_countscriptwarnStory with fewer than 2 acceptance criteria
invest_qualityLLMwarnStory failing an INVEST dimension
vaguenessLLMwarnUnquantified vague language ("fast", "easy")
core_value_driftLLMwarnNarrative drifts from PRODUCT.md core-value sentence
unaddressed_parentscriptwarnEpic or PRD with zero inbound child edges
🔍
Report format: after both layers run, the skill composes a human-readable report — a summary line count, an error section, a warnings section, and suggested next steps. The PO gets one clear list to act on.

Example run (illustrative — not captured output):

product-spec --validate --strict
# Validation Report — 2026-06-17

## Summary
- 18 artifacts checked
- 0 errors · 2 warnings
- Strict gate: ON (errors would block)

## Errors (0)
(none)

## Warnings (2)

### PRD-AUTH-E1-S2 — low_ac_count (warn)
Story has 1 acceptance criterion. Suggest ≥2.

### PRD-BILLING — core_value_drift (warn — LLM)
Alignment: weak — billing flow is tangential to core value.
Consider whether this PRD belongs in the next horizon.

## Suggested Next Steps
1. Add ≥1 AC to PRD-AUTH-E1-S2.
2. PRD-BILLING: discuss core-value alignment with stakeholders.
THE APPROVAL GATE

status: approved requires explicit PO sign-off — never automatic

--approve runs a full validation first (warns do not block), then checks for unresolved open markers (TBD, cần PO xác định), then records owner + date and flips status: approved. It never sets approved status on the PO's behalf without that explicit confirmation.

GATE-NEVER-ASSUME — approval sign-off The skill never sets status: approved without explicit PO approval, an owner name, and a date. Not even for boilerplate. Not even when the PO says "skip asking". The GATE is never waived — the skill proceeds but names the residual risk.
When approved, the frontmatter approval block is: 
approval:
  approved_by: "Jane Doe"
  approved_at: "2026-06-17"
  approved_version: "1.0.0"

After a successful sign-off, the skill nudges the PO that --export can produce one shareable copy and --viz can re-render visuals for the approved state. Both are suggestions, never automatic.

NEVER OVERWRITE PO PROSE

Operating Principle 4 — flag, then ask

When --update computes the downstream change set, it flags affected nodes for the PO's review — it never auto-rewrites them. Regeneration of any prose node is opt-in, per node, after the PO confirms. This applies to validation findings too: a vagueness warn surfaces a suggested rewrite but never applies it.

What the skill does on a finding

Surface verbatim

Show the existing prose and the finding detail — never paraphrase the PO's words.

Suggest, don't apply

Offer a concrete improvement if the finding allows it. Mark it clearly as a suggestion.

Wait for PO

Only proceed with a change after explicit PO confirmation. No silent edits.

Anti-rationalization traps

  • "I'll tidy their wording" → Flag, then ask.
  • "The scope is obvious, I'll set it" → Scope is PO's call.
  • "It contradicts approved, I'll fix it" → Surface Keep / Change / Hybrid.
